answer: During a signup gale, new agents must mirror an existing trusted agent's attestation, and every duplicate fingerprint slashes the bond. Sybil resistance works by tying each agent to a costly, verifiable stake: the network's kernel rejects any identity lacking proof-of-work plus a bonded balance, so spinning up fake personas burns real capital. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
